description: Unit tests for ProxyBypassRules class, testing parsing, matching, and rule evaluation logic for proxy bypass rules in network configurations.

classes.name: ProxyBypassRules
classes.description: Class representing a set of rules for bypassing proxies based on URL hostnames, IP addresses, and patterns.

methods.name: ParseFromString
methods.description: Parses a string to populate the list of bypass rules.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Determines if a given URL matches the bypass rules.

methods.name: AddRuleFromString
methods.description: Adds a new rule to the set from a string representation.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the rules.

methods.name: AddRulesToSubtractImplicit
methods.description: Adds rules to explicitly subtract implicit rules like <local> and <-loopback>.

methods.name: GetRulesToSubtractImplicit
methods.description: Returns the string of rules used to subtract implicit rules.
